prior_evidence.interpretation: Common-fit-only raw-proxy correlations, not v6 prediction errors. No new timeline model scores were inspected before declaration.

configuration.refit_iterations: Each active new global uses the ties-to-even rounded median of its two October-selected counts. Imported v6 airport and missing-clock components retain their original models and counts.
configuration.selection: Complete all eight native fits and all ten common candidate recipes. Require at least 0.5 percent lower complete RMSE on each original fold than v6, then minimize the equally weighted mean relative RMSE. No airport-specific weights or post-hoc changes.
